clause: Develop output routing via StudioExportRecipe + multi-image apply on canonical selection [STU-RAW-017]

scope.summary: Route save/output of a developed raw through StudioExportRecipe (14.13) for derived deliverables (DNG/TIFF/PNG/JPEG and layered document formats) with format-specific options, WITHOUT inventing a raw-develop-only export path that bypasses the 14.13 export contract. Implement multi-image apply — copy develop settings from one raw to a selection of others, paste-settings, previous, and preset apply across a filmstrip selection — operating on the CANONICAL selection set, not the visible/loaded subset.
acceptance_criteria: develop output via StudioExportRecipe; multi-image apply on canonical selection; no bypass
expected_tests: test: developed-raw save routes through StudioExportRecipe (no bypass path)
test: multi-image apply targets canonical selection set, not visible/loaded subset

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Output & multi-image apply

risk_if_missed: Bypass export path or partial-selection apply (SOT canonical-set violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
